metadata.purpose: Arabidopsis PSoup benchmark (Dataset S18_Benchmark_Model_Original.sbgn) -> Sorghum bicolor tillering ortholog/analog crosswalk
metadata.benchmark_source: APSIM_PSoup_Paper/Dataset S18_Benchmark_Model_Original.sbgn + Manuscript/Supplementary.docx Extended Data Table 1

genes.note: SbTB1/OsTB1, direct grass ortholog of Arabidopsis BRC1/BRC2 (TCP-class II), well-characterized in sorghum bud outgrowth
F-box LRR SL receptor complex component; sorghum-direct evidence exists (Kebrom 2010, phyB-SbMAX2 pathway)
alpha/beta-hydrolase SL receptor; sorghum locus named in Extended Data Table 1, primary functional evidence from rice
carotenoid cleavage dioxygenase 7, SL biosynthesis; rice ortholog well characterized, sorghum ortholog exists but less literature
carotenoid cleavage dioxygenase 8, SL biosynthesis; rice ortholog well characterized
4 CYP711A paralogs in sorghum genome catalyzing distinct SL biosynthesis steps (Yoda et al. 2021, New Phytologist, 10.1111/nph.17737) - sorghum-direct
iron-binding beta-carotene isomerase, first committed SL biosynthesis step; already grounded in existing Tillering_Sorghum network

Step 1.5 update: named rice methyltransferase acting on the noncanonical 4-oxo-CLA branch (vs Arabidopsis CLAMT acting on CLA directly), catalyzing formation of 4-oxo-MeCLA; identified via cross-species coexpression analysis alongside OsCYP706C2 (Kayoumu et al. 2024, Science Advances, 10.1126/sciadv.adq3942). Confirms the CLAMT enzyme class is real and named in rice, though on a divergent pathway branch from the canonical MAX1->CLAMT->LBO route the network models; oscyp706c2 mutants themselves show no tillering phenotype (root/mycorrhizal role instead), so no new curated_edges/perturbation entry was added on this DOI alone - documentation only.

Step 1.5 update: closed via T028 (perturbation_dataset.json) - Roesler et al. 2021, Frontiers in Plant Science, 10.3389/fpls.2021.639401: ectopic AtCXE20 expression in maize increases branches/tillers and reduces SL, giving CXE a real grass-species (maize) functional test (previously Arabidopsis-only via T014). Native rice CXE gene family exists (Frontiers 2024, 10.3389/fpls.2024.1435420) but no rice ortholog has been functionally tied to SL catabolism/tillering yet.
sorghum LBO ortholog implicated in SL biosynthesis / Striga response; exact supporting DOI to be confirmed during Step 1 search
SL-signalling repressor (SMAX1-LIKE); already grounded in existing Tillering_Sorghum network
SQUAMOSA-PROMOTER-BINDING-PROTEIN-LIKE; already grounded in existing Tillering_Sorghum network

transposase-derived light-signalling TFs; family characterized in maize (drought context) but no tillering-specific grass ortholog paper found yet - candidate literature_gap or Arabidopsis-flagged fallback
sorghum phyB-1 mutant directly studied for shade avoidance/tillering (Kebrom et al. 2006/2010) - sorghum-direct, already in existing network
PIF-like TFs directly shown to regulate rice tillering via OsTB1 (Zhang et al. 2022, New Phytologist); grass-direct
sorghum NCED paralog compared against OsNCED3 in phylogenetic studies; ABA biosynthesis, downstream of BRC1/HB21-40-53 axis
functional analog for bud polar auxin transport; Dw3 is an ABCB-type auxin transporter (not a PIN protein) already grounded in existing Tillering_Sorghum network with sorghum-direct DOIs

HD-Zip TF acting downstream of BRC1/TB1; GT1 is the closest characterized grass paralog (barley HvGT1), already grounded in existing Tillering_Sorghum network - functional analog, not a strict 1:1 ortholog
